newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra sees competitors to Losec in 2001.
newsitem.headline: Astra sees competitors to Losec in 2001.

text.p: Swedish drugs major Astra AB on Monday confirmed that it expected to see generic competition to its leading drug, the ulcer agent Losec, in the U.S. by the year 2001.
Company spokesman Staffan Ternby said Astra's patent on the formulation of Losec does not expire until 2007 but its molecular patent runs out in the year 2001.
"We are expecting some generic competition," Ternby told Reuters after the company posted its nine month results.
"We don't think the formulation patent can possibly cover everything ... although at least it will protect the current capsules we are marketing."
Losec, which is marketed as Prilosec in the U.S. by a joint venture with Merck Inc, is Astra's biggest selling drug.
In the nine months to September 30, Losec sales raised 12.74 billion crowns of a total 28.14 billion crowns for the company.
But Ternby said Astra was looking at introducing new patents over Losec with new development to maintain its market position.
"We are working on improvements to Losec which will be patented," he said.
